statement: However, as illustrated in Figure 2, some useful properties of the input digraph may not be preserved by the “flattening” operation. In particular, if U(D) has treewidth at most r, then the treewidth of U(F (D)) cannot be bounded by a constant in general. Furthermore, the graph U(F (D)) is not necessarily balanced1 (or planar) if U(D) is. Therefore, we cannot take advantage of polynomial-time algorithms for Set Cover on balanced incidence graphs or incidence graphs of bounded treewidth. Motivated by the example in Figure 2b we leave as an open question, whether Source Cover on balanced graphs admits a polynomial-time algorithm. By Theorem 8, the existence of such an algorithm implies a polynomial-time algorithm for Robust Matching Augmentation on balanced graphs.
